# A test that runs the getting-started guide's commands
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #180, sha256:8a5de8157be90972b9b1db767ad79bc3b05f60eb19c3a6affb2ece1a9cd8d566). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Ready
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** tooling (S; v0.1 bar 2)
- **Milestone:** Purpose: verifiability, preserved intent and reviewability
- **Source:** The v0.1 public preview bar (docs/release/v0.1-bar.md) and Decider D121 (2026-10-29).
- **Depends on:** 179, 176
- **Story:** As Dana, I want the guide to be true today and to stay true, so that I never follow a step that no longer works.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given the guide, When a test extracts its fenced commands and runs them in a temp workspace with the packed tool, Then every command exits as the guide says and the documented outputs appear
  2. Given a renamed route, field or command in the guide, When the test runs, Then it fails (shown by a mutation)
  3. Given CI, When the test runs on Linux and Windows, Then it passes on both

## Context

- Follow the pattern of tests/test_demo_readme.py (card 158). Follow docs/CODING_GUIDELINES.md; keep the change small enough to revert alone.
